description: Juicy pomelo segments with poached protein, coconut and herbs.
descriptionKm: ញាំក្រូចថ្លុង — ផ្អែម ត្រជាក់ និងស្រស់។

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាត ហើយហាន់ជាកង់

ingredients.itemKm: ក្រូចថ្លុង
ingredients.notesKm: កាត់ចែកចំណិត

ingredients.itemKm: ស្លឹកសុណ្ដ និងវ៉ាន់សុយ
ទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ
ម្ទេសខ្មាំង

instructions.text: Poach or grill the squid (cleaned and scored into rings) until just cooked, then slice thinly.
Whisk the dressing — lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, garlic and chili — until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the squid with pomelo, toasted coconut, mint & coriander.
Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.
